summary.text: Earl Harris is a Democratic state representative who represents Indiana House District 2, has served since 2016, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He worked in television production and public-school media before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Earl Harris, Jr. earned a B.A. in telecommunications from Indiana University and an M.A. in telecommunications, with a focus on digital storytelling, from Ball State.

His work experience includes serving as operations manager and later president of the Educational Television Cooperative and as department head and senior television producer/director of the IPS Television/Public Relations Division for Indianapolis Public Schools.
He also founded and owns a television and video production company, Motivation Media, and has been nominated for two Emmy Awards for programs he produced for FOX Sports Midwest.
Harris assumed office on November 9, 2016, succeeding Donna Harris, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Government and Regulatory Reform, Roads and Transportation, and Ways and Means committees.
